Episode 1: Seigaku VS Rikkai Mou Hitotsu no Tatakai!? (青学ＶＳ立海 もうひとつの戦い!?)
Episode 2: Inui no Kansatsu Nikki (乾の観察日記)
Episode 3: Aruhi no Sanada (或る日の真田)
